gemini-3-flash.notes: Good CRA tier classification and Track 2 detection. However, contains several accuracy issues: incorrect CVSS scores for some CVEs (e.g., CVE-2025-13465 shown as 8.2 vs actual 7.9), and some hallucinated details. Uses fixHint appropriately but exceeds word limit significantly.

gpt-4.1-mini.notes: Excellent CRA alignment with proper tier classification, Track 2 identification, and Art. 14 deadlines. Accurate CVE data matching source comparison. Comprehensive coverage of high-risk CVEs with proper fixHint citations. Well-structured actionable recommendations.

deepseek-v3.notes: Strong CRA tier usage and Track 2 detection. Highly accurate CVE data with no hallucinations. Excellent conciseness at 499 words. Good fixHint usage and age risk identification. Slightly less comprehensive than GPT-4.1-mini but very well-executed overall.

analysis: GPT-4.1-mini provides the most comprehensive and accurate analysis with excellent CRA alignment, properly identifying Track 2 requirements and citing all relevant articles. DeepSeek-v3 excels in conciseness and accuracy but is slightly less comprehensive. Gemini-3-flash has good structure but suffers from accuracy issues and verbosity.
